g.text: v28 · same binary, prepared model and weights · packed FP8 · RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120)
Dots / triangles: medians from 11 event samples in each order. Whiskers: full observed sample range across both orders, not confidence intervals.
All retained heads match an independent eager reference; three poisoned replays per graph; inputs and weights unchanged.
Network-only synthetic features; preparation excluded. No renderer, NGX host, native-DLL speed or 85% throughput claim.
